name: Adia
source:
A man recounts stories of a girl he was supposed to meet up one night. Many people have said multiple things about her. A lot of the information is by word of mouth or online. He's currently going through his own problems and has trouble figuring out what the truth is.

[From [url=http://natadecocoa.itch.io/adia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名男子讲述了一个女孩的故事，他本应在某个夜晚与她见面。许多人都谈论过她，许多信息来自口耳相传或网络。男子目前也在处理自己的问题，很难判断真相究竟是什么。

[摘自[url=http://natadecocoa.itch.io/adia]itch.io[/url]]
